title: Credit-Tier Surcharge Table for Deficiency Balance Account Plan Installments
content:
**Table rule.** The installment of a new payment plan on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts carries a surcharge read from the credit tier of the contract that produced the account, as recorded under Retail Installment Contracts: a contract of the tier Tier 6 Fresh Start carries a surcharge of 5.0 percent, a contract of the tier Tier 5 Rebuild carries 2.5 percent, and every other credit tier carries none.

| Credit tier of the liquidated Retail Installment Contract | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 5.0 percent |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 2.5 percent |
| Tier 4 Standard | None |
| Tier 3 Advantage | None |
| Tier 2 Preferred | None |
| Tier 1 Select | None |

## Points of reading

- The contract read is the liquidated contract recorded on the Deficiency Balance Account; the borrower's other contracts, open or closed, are not read.
- The credit tier is the one assigned to that contract at purchase, which never changes after booking.
- Hypothetically, a borrower whose liquidated contract was Tier 5 Rebuild and who now holds an open Tier 6 Fresh Start contract carries the 2.5 percent surcharge.
